library_preparation_preflight.summary: No dependency/Docker/env setup is needed; the only issue is that the existing ClassLoaderWeavingAdaptorTest reflects on an internal field (`defineClassMethod`) that AspectJ renamed/retyped to `defineClassMethodHandle` (a MethodHandle) between 1.9.7 and 1.9.21.1.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: When updating/regenerating tests for org.aspectj:aspectjweaver:1.9.21.1, note that ClassLoaderWeavingAdaptor no longer has a static field named `defineClassMethod` (java.lang.reflect.Method). It was replaced by a private static `defineClassMethodHandle` (java.lang.invoke.MethodHandle), populated by the private `createDefineClassMethodHandle()` method. The test helper `installLegacyDefineClassBridge()` in ClassLoaderWeavingAdaptorTest.java must not reflectively set the old `defineClassMethod` field for this version — either remove/skip that legacy-bridge installation (since `LangUtil.is11VMOrGreater()` is always true on JDK 25, so `usesLegacyDefineClassPath()` returns false and the legacy path is never exercised anyway), or adapt it to bind a MethodHandle to the new field name if exercising that path is still desired. No extra Maven dependency, Docker image, or system property is required beyond this.
risks: If the reflective field-name fix isn't applied, the java run (and any native-image run derived from it) will keep failing with NoSuchFieldException regardless of metadata content, masking whether metadata coverage itself is adequate.
